reviews.text: We hired MaidPro to do a cleaning of our home before a holiday party. Iyona and Shyann came out and got right to work. They did a great job on the bathrooms and kitchen. We really appreciated the help!
reviews.author: Tamara Young

reviews.text: Kimberly at MaidPro is great! Very thorough and follows up to ask if everything looks great- and it always does! Would definitely recommend her for house cleaning services. She also loves dogs!
reviews.author: Robert Emerson

reviews.text: We have used MaidPro for a couple years and always have a good experience. Every cleaner we have had is professional and provides a great clean. For most of this year we have had Latay who is always great! We previously had ShyAnn who was also great.
reviews.author: Rachael Mierzwa

reviews.text: MaidPro consistently provides great service. Isabella just did a cleaning of our home and you can tell she treated it as though it was her own!
reviews.author: Laura Kreiser

reviews.text: Isabella from the ambler location did such a great job on our house today! Would definitely recommend her and have her back again!!!
reviews.author: Daniel Smith
